core_obligations: Reduce to the objects of the base (proof lines 7549-7558): the author reduces the identification of the sheaves R^p g_*F with the colimit of the pullbacks of R^p g_{i,*}F_i to the values on etale S-schemes, using the description of the higher direct images as sheafified presheaves.

Use the limit (proof lines 7558-7564): on such an object the cohomology of the pullback of F is the colimit of the cohomologies of the pullbacks of the F_i, by the commutation of cohomology with the limit, which gives the displayed identification.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the values of the sheaves on etale S-schemes.
Use the description of higher direct images by cohomology on the base change.
Apply the commutation of cohomology with the limit to obtain the colimit presentation.
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the higher direct images of the colimit sheaf along the limit morphism with the colimit of the pullbacks of the higher direct images of the approximants (statement lines 7534-7547). The proof reduces the identification of sheaves to their values on etale S-schemes through the description of higher direct images as sheafified presheaves (proof lines 7549-7558) and then applies the commutation of cohomology with the limit of schemes (proof lines 7558-7564). The non-formal content is the reduction to the base, which is what makes the limit computation applicable. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one limit computation.
